review_summary: Review the complete fixed first-parent delta. Take the native interruption repair and verify live and retained scoped spend errors. Requalify the affected macOS consumer paths.
scope: The certificate covers this fixed source range. The exact artifact qualification and delivery have their own evidence.

records.behavior: Adds info spans for native MCP snapshot, refresh, readiness and catalog-publication stages. Existing lock and publish order remains in place. Binding misses box capture without allocating on cache hits.
records.decodex_consumer: Decodex reads native MCP status and retains exact environment-scoped identity through AppServerClient. Native Codex owns catalog refresh and call admission. Decodex has no reader for these new spans.
validation_limits: The local checks exercise retained MCP discovery and Apps recovery. They do not measure telemetry overhead or experimental shared connections.

records.behavior: Adds an authenticated inbound Noise transport for a registered remote executor. The CLI guards the transport selection. The receiver validates admission before dispatch and the client rejects admission headers on plaintext WebSockets.
records.decodex_consumer: The packaged exec-server is a retained helper. Decodex's environment fixture launches it on local stdio, without registry and without remote listen credentials. The ordinary stdio branch stays independent.
validation_limits: Exact-helper local stdio discovery covers the retained path. Remote provisioning and registry admission stay outside local execution.

records.behavior: Elevates recommendation loading, tooling-marker lookup and catalog requests to named info spans. Recommendation endpoint selection, cache behavior and fallback remain in the same functions.
records.decodex_consumer: Decodex observes native capabilities through app-server. The Agent bridge does not expose plugin recommendation management or read these spans. The source supplies no supported complete critical-path interface for the deferred item.
validation_limits: No Decodex timing or recommendations workflow is selected.

records.behavior: API-key, project and organization spend ceilings produce distinct terminal native errors and messages through HTTP and provider streaming. The native sampling error stops retry even with Retry-After. Live and stored app-server turn errors carry the same classification.
records.decodex_consumer: AgentCoordinator::record_terminal and AppServerClient::thread_read_turn consume native failure JSON. The bounded durable terminal projection retains its error object. Decodex schedules a capacity retry for exact serverOverloaded readback, while usageLimitExceeded retains its separate quota handling. The local native regression needed the new expectations.
validation_limits: The Decodex fixture uses loopback SSE response.failed, durable local turn evidence and cold app-server history. The reviewed upstream behavior also has HTTP and WebSocket coverage in source. No live-provider or subscription-account acceptance is inferred.

records.behavior: Moves Windows MXC launch and availability to the public V1 SDK. The Windows request builder translates filesystem, UI, network and environment policy to V1 and keeps separate command and policy directories.
records.decodex_consumer: The selected Decodex development pin prepares only aarch64-apple-darwin with scripts/macos/build_codex_source.mts. No Windows MXC artifact or SDK entrypoint is selected.
validation_limits: No Windows runtime was prepared or tested.

records.behavior: Canonical Codex thread URLs navigate inside the terminal transcript. The TUI resolves parent metadata before attaching the appropriate root and selecting a child. Missing and archived targets preserve drafts and explicit unarchive behavior.
records.decodex_consumer: Decodex displays native task links through decodex_protocol::conversation and its GPUI shell. Local launch and conversation controls use app-server, not upstream TUI renderer or its event dispatcher. No consumer protocol changed.
validation_limits: Upstream terminal navigation binds its own thread attachments. No desktop controls or new link policy are selected.

records.behavior: Provider-error and read-only TUI notices share blocked-thread rendering and route the advertised left-arrow action to the command center. The draft persists across the action, including offline.
records.decodex_consumer: Decodex owns GPUI provider recovery and uses the native structured provider error, including the retained explicit fork action. The upstream patch modifies the TUI key and notice handlers, without changing the app-server error.
validation_limits: No Decodex provider-recovery controls or policy changed.

records.behavior: Persistent MCP approval still writes the validated native tool policy and reloads the user config only after success. The reload future is allocated at that point, reducing the ordinary call future's inline size.
records.decodex_consumer: Decodex GPUI routes the exact MCP elicitation result to app-server. Native Codex owns persistent approval and reload. No policy, request shape or local reply needs modification.
validation_limits: The Decodex fixtures cover retained MCP calls and request handling. Native persistent config reload semantics are source evidence.

records.behavior: The macOS Bazel VoiceNativePrefix action now reserves the same eight CPU resources as its nested native build job count. Action inputs and native output selection stay the same.
records.decodex_consumer: Decodex prepares the official macOS CLI with scripts/macos/build_codex_source.mts and the upstream Cargo package builder. That path does not invoke the Bazel resource callback.
validation_limits: The Starlark patch has no changed behavioral test. The selected Cargo artifact is checked only through retained voice consumers.

records.behavior: Adds position-sensitive argument completion for built-in TUI slash commands. Tab rechecks the draft and live restriction before replacing the current token. The configured submit chord retains normal routing.
records.decodex_consumer: Decodex uses its GPUI composer and native application methods rather than the TUI slash parser or widgets. The upstream change exposes no new app-server capability.
validation_limits: Scope is terminal UX. No product change or local terminal test is needed.

records.behavior: Upstream repository Python formatting and the Python SDK fixture writer use a temporary UV environment that enforces hashes from its frozen lock. Scratch and experimental schema generation skip Python SDK regeneration.
records.decodex_consumer: Decodex prepares the CLI through the Cargo package builder and generates experimental JSON with the signed executable via decodex-components. It does not run the upstream repository formatter, Python SDK regeneration or the new UV runner.
validation_limits: Native schema generation from the prepared executable is within scope. Upstream tooling setup is outside runtime qualification.

records.behavior: On native interruption, already acknowledged queued agent mail is recorded in conversation history before the interrupted terminal event, even with the marker off. Remaining native terminal inputs stay in ordinary cleanup.
records.decodex_consumer: AgentCoordinator::interrupt_work sends the exact native turn interrupt. Decodex needs native result continuity through restart and does not recreate its queue. The preceding signed runtime lost the fixture mail before the same terminal event, so the native fix and named retained regression belong in this runtime selection.
validation_limits: The direct app-server fixture acknowledges one injected terminal child message while the prior request is blocked, checks the rollout at interruption, and verifies one native sample after cold resume. It does not simulate live provider timing or cover all preemption races.

records.behavior: Splits debug sandbox spawn from exit wait. A returned child retains its network proxy and can use piped streams. The existing macOS CLI entrypoint selects inherited streams and still waits, reports requested denials and propagates exit status.
records.decodex_consumer: Decodex sends native command requests through app-server and qualifies local Seatbelt permissions through command/exec. It does not invoke the debug CLI helper or its new pipe option.
validation_limits: The named Decodex command/exec fixture verifies the retained sandbox boundary on the prepared macOS artifact. Debug CLI piped mode is outside local execution.
